title: Petra Tour - The Rose City
overview: Explore the breathtaking rock-cut architecture and ancient wonders of Petra, the lost city of the Nabataeans in Jordan. Witness the stunning SIQ Crack, El Khazneh (The Treasury), and other ancient monuments on this full-day guided tour.
highlights: The Lost City - Ancient Nabataean capital carved into rose-red cliffs
The SIQ Crack - A 1-kilometer-long canyon leading to Petra
El Khazneh (The Treasury) - A 140-ft-high, 90-ft-wide carved monument
Ancient Nabataean Structures - Temples, tombs, and a Roman theater
excludes: Horse or donkey ride at the canyon
extra_tips: The entry visa to Petra is included in the price.
If you plan to visit Cairo or Luxor after Petra, do not get an entry visa for either until you return.
Tailor-made private tours are available for larger groups upon request.
recommendations: Request a breakfast box from your hotel
